**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

§ 18 already carries a complete vendor insurance clause that hits the preferred position on every material term:

| Playbook (preferred) | § 18.1 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M / 2M | ✅ USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate |
| E&O USD 2M | ✅ USD 2M |
| Cyber USD 5M (Customer Data) | ✅ USD 5M cyber and privacy |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✅ (plus USD 1M employer's liability) |
| Certificates on request | ✅ § 18.2 |

§ 18.2 adds reputable insurers, primacy over our own cover, advance notice of cancellation, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. All obligations bind Cobalt Cloud Services LLC and benefit us, so nothing to flag.
